item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Notice that your day already has a lot of structure, but food isn't one of the anchors. Pick a simple rhythm and protect it. Eat something with protein early, so you're not making choices on an empty stomach later. Slow down at your evening meal and put the phone away. Eating on purpose is part of caring for yourself. Your action: plan today's first meal right now, before anything else.
